description: Compares two glaze recipes side by side: for each, its recipe in percent, key unity formula figures, flux ratio (R2O against RO), silica to alumina, calculated expansion, place on Stull's chart (stull), the names of the limit cautions it has and, with a firing, whether its chemistry fits that firing (coneFit verdict); then what changes from A to B oxide by oxide (differences), which materials are in A only, in B only, or in both, with their percents, and a summary of the differences that matter (flux ratio, silica to alumina, silica, alumina and boron, expansion with fitFlag when the two differ by 0.3 x10^-6 per °C or more, so they may fit the same clay differently, Stull regions, the cautions only one side has, and coneFit). Give each recipe as lines (a, b) or, signed in to Glazecalc, one of your own saved recipes by its id from list_recipes (aRecipeId, bRecipeId): one or the other for each side. It is the same comparison blend_recipes makes with two recipes and two steps, under a name that is easy to find. Give base materials only, no colorants. This is a calculation from published figures, not a test result: fire both, and the tiles decide.

a.description: Recipe A as lines (or give aRecipeId instead).

amount.description: Its amount in the recipe, in any unit the other lines share (grams, parts, percent).

analysis.description: Only for a material not in the library: its oxides in weight percent, as { "SiO2": 68.5, "Al2O3": 17.4 }.

loi.description: Its loss on ignition in percent, with an analysis.

material.description: The material, by its name in the Glazecalc library ("Custer Spar", "Whiting", "EPK"), or your own name when you give its analysis.

aRecipeId.description: Recipe A as one of your own saved recipes, by its id from list_recipes (signed in only), instead of a.

b.description: Recipe B as lines (or give bRecipeId instead).

amount.description: Its amount in the recipe, in any unit the other lines share (grams, parts, percent).

analysis.description: Only for a material not in the library: its oxides in weight percent, as { "SiO2": 68.5, "Al2O3": 17.4 }.

loi.description: Its loss on ignition in percent, with an analysis.

material.description: The material, by its name in the Glazecalc library ("Custer Spar", "Whiting", "EPK"), or your own name when you give its analysis.

bRecipeId.description: Recipe B as one of your own saved recipes, by its id from list_recipes (signed in only), instead of b.

firing.description: The firing, as a cone or a temperature. Leave it out when it is not known. From cone 12 up (about 1320 °C) no published glaze limits reach, so the limits are not checked there; the cone check judges cone 06 to 10 only.

chart.description: Which cones the cone is: Orton (the default) or SK (JIS R 8101).

cone.description: An Orton cone from 022 to 42 ("06", "6", "10", "14", a half cone as "5.5"), or with chart "sk" an SK cone (JIS R 8101) from SK 022 to SK 20 ("6a", "8", "14").

labels.description: Names for A and B, two of them, such as ["Original", "With whiting"], echoed back.

language.description: The language for any sentences in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag such as "en", "de" or "ja". Languages Glazecalc does not offer are answered in English.

limitSet.description: The limits to check against, as check_limits takes it: "glazecalc" (the default) or "hesselberth-roy".

name: compare_recipes
title: Compare two recipes
